## Lint Pack SHO (shadow origin)

Tiers are ADR-0010 § 6: E2 lexical, E3 reflection, E4 runtime or boot-walk. The pack is registered with ADR-0010 (Foundation ask F3). Every rule has a bad and a good fixture (FIX-01).

| Rule | What it forbids or checks | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| SHO-01 | A `Light2D` `position` is written only by `Placement.put_light_origin` (the `PRES-03` allow-list entry); no `Placement.put`, `position =`, `global_position =` or relative-move call on a `Light2D` | E2 |
| SHO-02 | A `Light2D` `offset` is written only in `beam_offset_writer.gd` (the second `PRES-03` allow-list entry), and never from `src/presentation/controller/` | E2 |
| SHO-03 | Dev-build every-frame check: for each `Light2D` in group `light_origin`, `global_position` has a fractional part of exactly 0.5 on both axes (lattice), and for each hard-shaped light the recomputed apex equals `render(o) + v` within 0.01 px (apex); counters `shadow_origin_lattice_fail` and `shadow_origin_apex_fail`, CI asserts zero | E4 |
| SHO-04 | Boot walk: every beam `Light2D`'s parent is a non-rotating body-frame node (no `rotation` write to it, no rotated ancestor up to the body frame), and no `Light2D` is a descendant of the avatar or the tool layer | E4 |
| SHO-05 | Every `OccluderPolygon2D` the builder creates has `cull_mode` `CULL_DISABLED` (token scan of the builder plus a boot-walk read-back of every pooled node) | E2 and E4 |
| SHO-06 | Every pooled `LightOccluder2D` polygon vertex has integer coordinates in the body frame and the vertex set equals the union of the `OCCLUDES_LIGHT` rectangles it was built from (LO-11 set equality); a vertex off the lattice fails | E4 |

## Foundation Asks

- **F1 (ADR-0009 § 4, Placement)**: add `Placement.CELL_CENTRE` and `Placement.put_light_origin(node: Light2D, p: Vector2i)` (§ 3.1); exempt nodes in group `light_origin` from the `PLACEMENT_FRACTIONAL` integral sweep and have the sweep assert the 0.5 lattice for them instead (SHO-03); amend the sentence "the beam's chest point and the Avatar sprite use the same rounded position" to say both start from the same integer cell and the light node is that cell plus `CELL_CENTRE`.
- **F2 (ADR-0009 § 4 and ADR-0010 § 6.6, `PRES-03`)**: two named allow-list entries: `Placement.put_light_origin` as the only writer of a `Light2D` `position`, and `src/presentation/lighting/beam_offset_writer.gd` as the only writer of a `Light2D` `offset` (distinct from `Sprite2D.offset`, which stays banned).
- **F3 (ADR-0010 § 6.6 and ADR-0007 § 2)**: register the lint pack SHO-01 to SHO-06; reserve the domain-2 boot code `LIGHT_SHADOW_ORIGIN_COMBO` (§ 6) in the content-validation code list.
- **F4 (ADR-0008, Verification Required and the driver tie-break)**: name the probe pack of § 8.2 as one of the correctness checks lighting spike steps 1, 2 and 9 consult when the renderer or driver is chosen ("Vulkan fails a correctness check D3D12 passes"), so the same retained evidence serves both ADRs.

## Cross-ADR Assumptions

- **ADR-0017 (Emitter state; same wave, not on disk)**: `beam_pose` carries `origin` (the chest) and `occ_origin` (the foot, `pos_curr`) as separate fields and `emitter.place` reads the chest offset from the Controller view; the segment test is EM-20 (a) over doubled closed boxes starting at the cell centre of `occ_origin`, as a pure function the probe pack reuses; `OCC_ORIGIN_MODE` is reserved with one value (FOOT) and outcome D is an amendment of ADR-0017 plus § 7 here, publishing a previous/current `occ_origin` pair only if D is adopted.
- **ADR-0019 (Player controller; same tier)**: the Avatar Presenter's beam `position` write (§ 7.2 "the chest `Light2D`'s `position` and `rotation`") means, under mode B, `Placement.at` of the **foot** from `body.state` plus `CELL_CENTRE`, written through `put_light_origin`, and not the chest point; the chest offset is read from `ControllerView`; `rotation` stays the Presenter's.
- **ADR-0028 (Lighting budget; not yet written)**: carries items (a) to (f) of § 1 by reference; owns the disjoint `Light2D` member sets (TR-light-006) and the shadow-slot assignment; chooses the `shadow_filter` level using SO-P8.
- **ADR-0014 (OccluderSource)**: `rects_in` and `section_rects_into` return the `OCCLUDES_LIGHT` rectangles as half-open integers through a caller-owned `QueryBuffer`, so the occluder builder's polygons and the Emitter's segment test read one set; no shift is applied by Layout.
- **ADR-0015 (Body)**: `body.state` exposes `pos_x`, `pos_y`, `prev_x`, `prev_y` for the actor as integers in the body frame, readable by PRESENTATION.
- **ADR-0034 (PROJECTOR)**: tiles and rectangles are drawn at integer body-frame origins with cell n covering `[n, n + 1)`, and the body frame offset is one floored integer per body, so the polygon lattice is integer and the light lattice (integer plus one half) is consistent on every live body.
- **ADR-0008 (Pipeline)**: under pass A the world viewport rasterises at base resolution; the snap flags are on as a safety net and, as probed in pass A, do not round a `Light2D` position (SO-P5 re-checks, including pass B).

| Rule | What it forbids or checks | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| SHO-01 | A `Light2D` `position` is written only by `Placement.put_light_origin` (the `PRES-03` allow-list entry); no `Placement.put`, `position =`, `global_position =` or relative-move call on a `Light2D` | E2 |
| SHO-02 | A `Light2D` `offset` is written only in `beam_offset_writer.gd` (the second `PRES-03` allow-list entry), and never from `src/presentation/controller/` | E2 |
| SHO-03 | Dev-build every-frame check: for each `Light2D` in group `light_origin`, `global_position` has a fractional part of exactly 0.5 on both axes (lattice), and for each hard-shaped light the recomputed apex equals `render(o) + v` within 0.01 px (apex); counters `shadow_origin_lattice_fail` and `shadow_origin_apex_fail`, CI asserts zero | E4 |
| SHO-04 | Boot walk: every beam `Light2D`'s parent is a non-rotating body-frame node (no `rotation` write to it, no rotated ancestor up to the body frame), and no `Light2D` is a descendant of the avatar or the tool layer | E4 |
| SHO-05 | Every `OccluderPolygon2D` the builder creates has `cull_mode` `CULL_DISABLED` (token scan of the builder plus a boot-walk read-back of every pooled node) | E2 and E4 |
| SHO-06 | Every pooled `LightOccluder2D` polygon vertex has integer coordinates in the body frame and the vertex set equals the union of the `OCCLUDES_LIGHT` rectangles it was built from (LO-11 set equality); a vertex off the lattice fails | E4 |

input.summary:
ADR-0018 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) keeps shadow origin as its own small spike-gated Core ADR instead of folding it into ADR-0028. It decides:

- **Contract:** the drawn shadow origin must equal the simulation's occlusion origin on the same lattice. The measure is a boundary-robust mismatch count: zero mismatches at radius 2 reads AC-57's 2 px, and radius 1 is recorded.
- **Lattice rule:** the simulation's cell is centred on its integer coordinate while the render pixel spans [n, n+1), so every Light2D is placed at its integer cell plus CELL_CENTRE (0.5, 0.5) through a new Placement.put_light_origin. Occluder polygons stay on integer corners, with CULL_DISABLED and no shift.
- **Mechanism ladder:** B (node at the lattice foot, offset carries the apex via BeamOffset.offset_for, LOCAL frame) is the design of record. A is run as a control arm and is predicted to fail. D is a specified contingency that is not built. C stays rejected. The mode is a LightingTuning row, with a boot invariant on the (Emitter OCC_ORIGIN_MODE, SHADOW_ORIGIN_MODE) pair.
- **Occluder reach set:** measured from the apex, with a convexity proof that no blocking rectangle is missed.
- **Spike and gate:** step 3b, probes SO-P1..SO-P9 and a 140-row AC-57 matrix. The result is appended by amendment as `## Spike Result`; the ADR is not Accepted before that.
- **Document sections:** a lint pack SHO-01..06, Foundation asks F1..F4 and Cross-ADR assumptions.

Twelve windowed probes were run on 4.7.2 (Forward+/Vulkan, RTX 4070 Laptop, editor dev build, with a Compatibility cross-check); they are evidence, not the gate. The shadow origin follows the node and ignores offset and rotation. Offset is node-local and unscaled. The apex lands exactly. B had 0 mismatches over 88,831 cells at all six AC-57 s values. A rendered a black beam while the simulation reported 24,191 cells lit, and 27% to 66% of cells were wrong for s<=20. The half-cell lattice cut mismatches 3x to 10x and left zero beyond radius 1.

toolu_011gYGfo4YVD1AwRzEa97chr.summary:
ADR-0018 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) keeps shadow origin as its own small spike-gated Core ADR instead of folding it into ADR-0028. It decides:

- **Contract:** the drawn shadow origin must equal the simulation's occlusion origin on the same lattice. The measure is a boundary-robust mismatch count: zero mismatches at radius 2 reads AC-57's 2 px, and radius 1 is recorded.
- **Lattice rule:** the simulation's cell is centred on its integer coordinate while the render pixel spans [n, n+1), so every Light2D is placed at its integer cell plus CELL_CENTRE (0.5, 0.5) through a new Placement.put_light_origin. Occluder polygons stay on integer corners, with CULL_DISABLED and no shift.
- **Mechanism ladder:** B (node at the lattice foot, offset carries the apex via BeamOffset.offset_for, LOCAL frame) is the design of record. A is run as a control arm and is predicted to fail. D is a specified contingency that is not built. C stays rejected. The mode is a LightingTuning row, with a boot invariant on the (Emitter OCC_ORIGIN_MODE, SHADOW_ORIGIN_MODE) pair.
- **Occluder reach set:** measured from the apex, with a convexity proof that no blocking rectangle is missed.
- **Spike and gate:** step 3b, probes SO-P1..SO-P9 and a 140-row AC-57 matrix. The result is appended by amendment as `## Spike Result`; the ADR is not Accepted before that.
- **Document sections:** a lint pack SHO-01..06, Foundation asks F1..F4 and Cross-ADR assumptions.

Twelve windowed probes were run on 4.7.2 (Forward+/Vulkan, RTX 4070 Laptop, editor dev build, with a Compatibility cross-check); they are evidence, not the gate. The shadow origin follows the node and ignores offset and rotation. Offset is node-local and unscaled. The apex lands exactly. B had 0 mismatches over 88,831 cells at all six AC-57 s values. A rendered a black beam while the simulation reported 24,191 cells lit, and 27% to 66% of cells were wrong for s<=20. The half-cell lattice cut mismatches 3x to 10x and left zero beyond radius 1.

data.summary:
ADR-0018 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) keeps shadow origin as its own small spike-gated Core ADR instead of folding it into ADR-0028. It decides:

- **Contract:** the drawn shadow origin must equal the simulation's occlusion origin on the same lattice. The measure is a boundary-robust mismatch count: zero mismatches at radius 2 reads AC-57's 2 px, and radius 1 is recorded.
- **Lattice rule:** the simulation's cell is centred on its integer coordinate while the render pixel spans [n, n+1), so every Light2D is placed at its integer cell plus CELL_CENTRE (0.5, 0.5) through a new Placement.put_light_origin. Occluder polygons stay on integer corners, with CULL_DISABLED and no shift.
- **Mechanism ladder:** B (node at the lattice foot, offset carries the apex via BeamOffset.offset_for, LOCAL frame) is the design of record. A is run as a control arm and is predicted to fail. D is a specified contingency that is not built. C stays rejected. The mode is a LightingTuning row, with a boot invariant on the (Emitter OCC_ORIGIN_MODE, SHADOW_ORIGIN_MODE) pair.
- **Occluder reach set:** measured from the apex, with a convexity proof that no blocking rectangle is missed.
- **Spike and gate:** step 3b, probes SO-P1..SO-P9 and a 140-row AC-57 matrix. The result is appended by amendment as `## Spike Result`; the ADR is not Accepted before that.
- **Document sections:** a lint pack SHO-01..06, Foundation asks F1..F4 and Cross-ADR assumptions.

Twelve windowed probes were run on 4.7.2 (Forward+/Vulkan, RTX 4070 Laptop, editor dev build, with a Compatibility cross-check); they are evidence, not the gate. The shadow origin follows the node and ignores offset and rotation. Offset is node-local and unscaled. The apex lands exactly. B had 0 mismatches over 88,831 cells at all six AC-57 s values. A rendered a black beam while the simulation reported 24,191 cells lit, and 27% to 66% of cells were wrong for s<=20. The half-cell lattice cut mismatches 3x to 10x and left zero beyond radius 1.

decisions.point: Fold into ADR-0028 or keep separate
decisions.chosen: Keep ADR-0018 separate; ADR-0028 carries the Lighting implementation by reference after Acceptance (fold-down rule, items a-f in section 1)
decisions.reason: The spike has not run so the fold condition is unmet; outcome D edits the Core Emitter and a Presentation ADR cannot carry a simulation contingency; the Presenter and Emitter stories need the interface before ADR-0028 exists.

decisions.chosen: Identity of origin on one lattice, measured by a boundary-robust mismatch count (zero at radius 2 = AC-57's 2 px; radius 1 recorded)
decisions.reason: Parallax arithmetic: a tolerance at the subject cannot be met by an approximately equal origin near a wall; probe P-8 showed integer placement leaves disagreements beyond 1 px from the simulation boundary.

decisions.chosen: B: node at the lattice foot, Light2D.offset carries the apex; ladder B, A (control arm), D (contingency), C rejected

decisions.chosen: Every Light2D position = integer cell + CELL_CENTRE (0.5, 0.5) via Placement.put_light_origin (Foundation asks F1, F2)

decisions.chosen: Unchanged: integer vertices, CULL_DISABLED, no shift
decisions.reason: Shifting by -1/2 breaks LO-11 integer set equality and puts faces through pixel centres; CULL_CLOCKWISE leaks 35.94 % even with the chest outside (probed).

decisions.chosen: Implement LOCAL only (probed LOCAL, unscaled, both renderers); WORLD added by amendment if a reference machine disagrees
decisions.reason: No dead code for an unobserved branch; the probe pack SO-P2 reports it.

decisions.chosen: Measured from the apex (chest point) for every outcome; OCC_MARGIN_PX keeps the GDD's per-outcome values
